title: can't reference folders and files starting with `.` , e.g., `.claude`
body:
running on macOS 15.5 in Ghostty. latest claude code version.

I am able to reference with `@` just fine most of the files in repo. however, files located in `.claude` or any other folder starting with `.` are not being picked up by `@` command.

is that a bug or by design?
author: simicvm
